method: Every retained original was individually viewed at original resolution in sequential tool batches.
observations: All 12 retained originals were individually viewed at original resolution. Full Unicode file and branch names wrap in light/dark hints while their originating controls retain blue keyboard outlines.
Preview-path hints remain visible in all six theme/zoom combinations. At dark 150 percent the originating path is truncated but the hint is complete; narrow views use a compact sidebar and file tab.
Project headings, long root paths and other file rows are truncated or require scrolling at large zoom. The dark 150-percent branch image does not display all lower change-list rows.

The light PDF view shows page one, the link target hint and footer. The dark narrow 150-percent view retains the link hint, reading controls and footer while only a small vertically scrollable document slice is visible. These two images do not verify every PDF page or document format.
scope: Current packaged visual fixtures only. Native assertions separately establish interactions and state retention. Complete reference adoption, physical Windows scaling and native installer wizard verification remain separate.
